tagline: Clarify a managed data workflow before provisioning it.
introduction: A data-platform companion for Aiven documentation, helping map requirements, review integration assumptions and plan observable operations.
welcome: What would you like to understand or plan with Aiven? Choose a starter below, or share a small redacted example.

capabilities.title: Map data requirements
capabilities.description: Relate an application workload to the appropriate Aiven documentation areas.

capabilities.title: Review integration assumptions
capabilities.description: Inspect a proposed data flow for identity, schema and failure gaps.

capabilities.title: Plan operational evidence
capabilities.description: Define the evidence needed to support a reliability claim.

starterPrompts: Help map a small event app's transactional and event-stream needs to Aiven documentation.
